findings.problem: Step 4 takes the lookup organization from the untrusted request body, so an admin of any organization can refund another organization's invoice by sending its orgId, which defeats SPEC AC-4 (that case must be 404 not_found); findInvoice's own comment says the org comes from the principal.
findings.evidence: `refundInvoice` loads the invoice with `findInvoice(doc, body.orgId ?? principal.orgId, id)`, so a parent organization's admin can refund on behalf of a child organization by sending its `orgId`

findings.problem: The parent/child organization capability appears nowhere in the SPEC and the live data model has no hierarchy (orgs are flat {id, name} records in test/helpers.js and src/store.js), so this is a speculative addition with no triggering need.
findings.evidence: so a parent organization's admin can refund on behalf of a child organization by sending its `orgId`; an id that matches no invoice there is `404 not_found` (AC-4)

findings.problem: The existing version-1 case in test/store.test.js asserts schemaVersion equals 2 (line 26), so after SCHEMA_VERSION becomes 3 it fails, yet the plan says to keep it unchanged and that the existing suites stay green.
findings.evidence: Keep the existing version-1 case: it now runs both steps in sequence.

findings.problem: Client-chosen Idempotency-Key strings become property names of the plain-object refundKeys map, and the allowed printable ASCII set includes __proto__, constructor and toString, which on a plain object read as inherited properties (false replay hit) or are not stored as own keys (duplicate refund on retry); the plan names no own-key lookup or null-prototype structure.
findings.evidence: look it up in `invoice.refundKeys`. A hit returns the stored refund with `replayed: true` and changes nothing

findings.problem: The plan maps all seven acceptance tests through AC-TESTS.md, but pharn/features/invoice-refunds/ holds only PLAN.md and SPEC.md at this run, so the artifact the plan points to does not exist and the test mapping cannot be checked.
findings.evidence: Their tests are mapped in `AC-TESTS.md` and written by `/pharn-test` before the build

findings.problem: AC-5 needs a request carrying an Idempotency-Key header, but request(method, path, token, body) in test/helpers.js cannot send extra headers and test/helpers.js is in neither Files nor Explicitly not touched, so the AC-5 integration test has no declared way to be written.
findings.evidence: AC-5 → step 7: the per-invoice idempotency map and the 200 replay. Test: "a retried request records one refund".

findings.problem: The audit call uses an unbound orgId; if it is the step 4 lookup org then a cross-org refund is logged in the other organization's audit log, and AC-6 (GET /audit by the refunding admin shows the entry) only holds when it is principal.orgId, which the plan never states.
findings.evidence: Then `record(doc, {orgId, actor: principal.keyId, action: "invoice.refunded", target: invoice.id, details: {refundId, amount}})` (AC-6).

findings.problem: The downgrade risk is closed by pointing at a README upgrade line that README.md does not have (no upgrade text in it) and that Step 11 does not add, so the one-way migration (the first write replaces the v2 file with v3) is mitigated by a document change nobody is told to make.
findings.evidence: Deploys are forward-only today; this is noted in the README's upgrade line.

findings.problem: refundInvoice takes now with no default while the route in step 10 does not pass it, so step 8's now.toISOString() would throw a TypeError and answer 500 as written; the return shape that lets the route tell a replay from a new refund is also unstated, since presentRefund drops the replayed flag.
findings.evidence: Create `src/refunds.js` exporting `refundInvoice(doc, principal, id, body, idempotencyKey, now)`, `listRefunds(doc, principal, id)` and `presentRefund(refund)`.
